text:
Marta Salas: Heads-up — planning to enable boron-l2 in the model catalog tomorrow during the 23:00-03:00 UTC change window. Canary plan: 5% for 30m -> 25% for 1h -> 100%. Updating fallback ordering as part of the rollout. Posting rollout checklist here.

Kai Chen: change window ok for us, that sits in low-traffic hours. any region restrictions?

Marta Salas: EU and US primary. APAC hold for now. We'll throttle APAC to avoid cross-region fanout.

Alice G: checklist: canary, trace hooks, pin fallback, QA eval set, alert thresholds, rollback playbook.

Ravi Kapoor: propose fallback ordering: boron-l2, boron-l1, titan-quant, legacy-small. We should pin boron-l1 as the immediate cold fallback to avoid jumping to heavy titan variants.

Alice G: +1 on pin boron-l1. Also set dedicated test pool for canary so we can isolate perf regressions.

Marta Salas: added. Draft rollback triggers: p95 latency increase > 30% vs baseline for 10m OR error rate > 1.5% over 5m OR eval-quality drop (automated eval) >= 2% top-level metric. If any trigger fires, immediate rollback to pinned fallback (boron-l1).

Ravi Kapoor: Can we keep a soft-alert for 20% p95 increase so oncall gets a heads-up before auto-rollback?

Marta Salas: yep — soft alert at 20% (notify #eng-oncall), hard rollback at 30% (autotrigger).

Marta Salas: I'll patch the catalog config. Snippet:
```json
{
  "model": "boron-l2",
  "canary": { "pct": 5, "duration_minutes": 30 },
  "ramp": [ {"pct":25, "duration_minutes":60}, {"pct":100, "duration_minutes":30} ],
  "fallback_order": ["boron-l1","titan-quant","legacy-small"],
  "pinned_fallbacks": ["boron-l1"]
}
```

deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout: /deploy catalog enable boron-l2 --canary 5% --canary-duration 30m --ramp 25:60,100:30 --fallback boron-l1,titan-quant,legacy-small --pin boron-l1 --window 2025-06-10T23:00Z/2025-06-11T03:00Z

Kai Chen: before go, set tracing level to DEBUG for canary only and capture 5% sampling for request traces. Will enable temporary trace retention to 72h.

Ravi Kapoor: also add an eval-run job that compares boron-l2 vs boron-l1 on the existing smoke prompt set every 15m during canary. If quality deviates, fire eval alert.

Marta Salas: done on the plan. I'll be oncall during the window and monitoring dashboards (latency, errors, cost per token, eval score). If anything odd, we'll hit rollback and post a short incident in #incidents.

Alice G: one last ask — add a note in release notes: model version, quantization (int8), expected perf delta, known diffs in tokenization if any. Keeps customers/SEs aware.

Marta Salas: will publish release notes before start, and leave the pin + rollback playbook in the catalog entry.

deploy-bot: Reminder in 1h: confirm canary envs are ready and smoke tests green. To rollback run: `/deploy catalog rollback boron-l2 --to boron-l1 --reason <short-reason>`

Kai Chen: ACK. I'll run canary smoke and post results. :thumbsup:

Ravi Kapoor: ACK — tracing and eval hooks set.

Alice G: ACK from QA side — smoke tests green on staging.

Marta Salas: thanks everyone. launching sequence tomorrow at 23:00 UTC if no blockers. :rocket:
